fields.Name: IT156 - Widget Guest Row Isolation
fields.Description: Two widget guest principals (the shared Anonymous user with the Widget Guest role and different session scopes), each with its own Conversation and one row per entity. Guest B reads none of guest A's MJ: AI Agent Requests, MJ: Conversation Skills, MJ: Conversation Detail Artifacts or MJ: AI Agent Runs rows (WG1); each guest reads its own (WG2); a guest with no scope reads none (WG3); guest B's update of A's Agent Request, Conversation Skill and Agent Run is refused and leaves the row unchanged (WG4); guest A updates its own (WG5); the system user reads both guests' rows (WG6). Server transport; fixtures removed in teardown.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Widget guests read and update only the rows of their own session; a guest with no scope reads nothing.
